properties.project_name: P24 -- waterfront lawn (Bayfront Park approach, south of 499 Illinois St)
properties.digitized_from: Outlined as the open ground left between DataSF's official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes around the 499 Illinois St / Bayfront Park area (one piece of 19,181.78 sqm before cutting). Pier & Point split that piece in three at its two natural narrow points (lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then cut it by hand the same way as P26: the wide, single 'head' was kept and the thin, branching 'horns' were dropped. Not taken from a surveyed parcel.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had P24 'landing exactly inside the already-tracked real footprint of 499 Illinois Street / Alexandria Center, not a separate undeveloped parcel'). Re-derived via the numbered real-gap-fragment technique: fragment 2 (19,181.78 sqm) was first split into 3 pieces at real cross-sectional width-scan waists (piece0 south lawn, piece1 middle plaza, piece2 north lawn). P24 = piece0 (the south lawn, 7,464 sqm), then cut with the same nseg-based fork technique as P26: a width-cross-section scan found the cross-section splits from a single segment into 2-3 separate segments at lat 37.76562 (the point where the 499 Illinois St building's stepped corner intrudes from the north), matching a 'head with two horns' shape -- kept only the single-segment head south of that latitude (6,616 sqm, the clean triangular Bayfront-Park-style lawn with its curved path) and dropped both thin sidewalk-hugging horns above it (848 sqm total, hugging the UCSF parking structure to the west and 499 Illinois St to the east). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: sources for the parcel label and status are now listed in source_doc_urls (OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map labels P24; OCII Sept 2023 transition deck lists P24 among parcels the Port will manage, not among 'when built' parcels). The lawn, path and trees are an imagery observation with no document cited. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- landscaped open land (lawn, curved path, scattered trees) as seen in Esri satellite imagery (an imagery observation; no document cited) and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, cut at an owner-directed cross-sectional fork point rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass; a hedged observation from imagery (no source cited) that it visually resembles Bayfront Park's own style and may be a continuation of it.'; digitized_from: 'Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the 499 Illinois St / Bayfront Park area (fragment 2, 19,181.78 sqm raw). The owner reviewed a 3-way width-scan split of that fragment (at its two real cross-sectional waists, lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then directed the same fork-cut technique used for P26: keep the wide single-segment 'head', drop the thin multi-segment 'horns'.'; notes: 'OCII plan open-space parcel P24 (the label appears on OCII's December 2019 Mission Bay Land Use Map). Triangular waterfront lawn south of 499 Illinois St, along Terry Francois Blvd, adjoining the Bayfront Park path (location from this project's own tracing).'. CHECKED 2026-10-11 (no change to the shape): the owner asked whether Assessor lot 3941032 should replace the drawing. DataSF's Assessor layer has active lot 3941032 (MB-RA zoning, recorded 2018-10-02, active, 10,721 m2) near this park: 86% of this drawing lies inside it and the drawing covers 53% of the lot; the lot is larger than this park (10,721 m2 against 6,605 m2), so using it would claim ground beyond the park, so the lot is not this park's own and the drawing is kept. geometry_type stays 'approximate'. 2026-10-12 accuracy audit follow-up (text only; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): the caveat said 'Name and operator not confirmed by any source found', but two sources this record cites say more. OCII's Sept 2023 transition deck (slide 5, 'Funding Agreement') says 'Port will manage P18, P21, P23, & P24 (plus P22 & P19 when built)', an operator named as planned in September 2023. SocketSite's April 22, 2019 and June 3, 2019 posts both say 'the nearly 2-acre Mariposa Bayfront Park (P23/P24) is expected to be completed by the end of this year' (an expected date written in 2019): a name for the combined P23/P24 area, not a source for this lawn's own name. The caveat now says so, matching the P23 record's caveat. The lawn, path and trees remain an imagery observation with no document cited, as the caveat states. Previous wording of the sentence: 'Name and operator not confirmed by any source found; a hedged observation from imagery (no source cited) that it visually resembles Bayfront Park's own style and may be a continuation of it.' Both SocketSite posts are added to source_doc_urls. The overlap was removed: the outline is now this drawing minus lot 3940003 (6,605 m2 before, 6,096 m2 after), so the park's edge along the lot is the lot's own recorded line (the lot's vertices, no simplification). The rest of the outline is unchanged. The lot's southern edge (from its vertex at lon -122.3878837, lat 37.7655369 to its vertex at lon -122.3869408, lat 37.7655937) is now extended straight west and east until it meets this drawing's own west and east edges, and everything north of that line is dropped, so the park's north edge is one straight continuation of the lot's edge. 6,096 m2 before, 6,018 m2 after (78 m2 removed); the other edges are unchanged.
